title: Alameda, Contra Costa and San Francisco residential utilities evidence
method: Only municipal, public utility or current contracted utility/provider websites were used. Oakland Recycles is the official City of Oakland/WM/CWS partnership linked by the city.
Each source records access honestly: opened, official search-index text, or both. Failed direct opens are not treated as successful live form or account tests.
Provider names and contacts are city-level routing guidance. No private residential address was submitted and no eligibility, installation, account creation or booking was tested.
Where local-directory telephone numbers differed, the utility's current account page took priority. PG&E 877-660-6789 and CCWD 925-688-8000 are account-service choices.
Water wholesalers, wastewater agencies and untreated irrigation suppliers were not presented as interchangeable household drinking-water account providers.
CCA providers are listed separately from distribution utilities. No claim is made that a particular account is enrolled, that a product is cheaper, or that city boundaries match postal addresses.
Chinese notes in utilities-east-sf.json have normalized flat-dictionary translations in utilities-east-sf-en.json; source ledger prose is English.
No prices, deposits, service-day schedules, appointment availability or 2025 promotions were carried into the city directory.
keyExceptions: Alameda electricity is Alameda Municipal Power; PG&E is not listed as its electricity account provider.
Hayward: municipal water versus EBMUD by address; WM opens garbage accounts while Tri-CED handles residential recycling.
Livermore: municipal water versus Cal Water; use Find My Provider before applying.
San Leandro: ACI versus WM/Oro Loma geographic waste areas.
Oakland, Berkeley, Union City and El Cerrito split waste/recycling responsibilities between providers.
Martinez, Pleasant Hill, San Ramon and Walnut Creek have multiple drinking-water service areas.
Pleasant Hill explicitly has CCWD, EBMUD and Martinez municipal drinking-water areas. Diablo Vista untreated irrigation water is excluded.
Concord, Oakley and Pittsburg use MDRR collection; Walnut Creek/RecycleSmart areas use Republic collection rather than confusing MDRR processing with collection.
Hercules is an MCE member; Antioch, Brentwood, Clayton and Orinda are not on the checked MCE member list.
San Francisco: PG&E delivery/CleanPowerSF generation differs from limited Hetch Hetchy Power service; Recology company assignment depends on address.
